description: List transfers of a specific token (by its contract address) within a time window. Defaults to the last 7 days; adjust via timestampFrom/timestampTo (max ~90 days). For very high-volume tokens, narrow the window to avoid upstream timeouts. Keyset pagination via `cursor`.

cursor.description: Keyset pagination cursor: pass the `id` of the last item from the previous response.

network.description: Network to query. Defaults to the server's configured network (mainnet).

pageSize.description: Items per page: 10, 25, 50, or 100. Defaults to 25. Keep small to save context.

timestampFrom.description: Start of time range (Unix seconds). Defaults to 7 days ago.

timestampTo.description: End of time range (Unix seconds). Defaults to now.

name: get_token_transfers
